gloss: hermit; recluse; person who has renounced the world

definitions.gloss: hermit; recluse; person who has renounced the world
definitions.explanation: A person who has withdrawn from society and worldly concerns. Can refer to historical hermits, monks, or modern people who live in isolation by choice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世捨|よす}て{人|びと}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
⟦{山奥|やまおく}→山奥：12438_yamaoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{世捨|よす}て{人|びと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}っている→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: He leads a reclusive life deep in the mountains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定年|ていねん}→定年：07500_teinen⟧⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧、⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れて→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧{世捨|よす}て{人|びと}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしたい→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: After retirement, I want to leave the city and live quietly in the countryside like a hermit.

notes:
USAGE:
Literally "person who has abandoned the world" (⟦{世|よ}→世：00424_yo⟧ = the world + ⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ = to abandon + {人|びと} = person). Has a literary, somewhat romantic nuance. Often used metaphorically rather than literally — describing someone who lives very simply or avoids social engagement.

NOTE: In Japanese literary tradition, there are famous {世捨|よす}て{人|びと} such as the poet {鴨|かもの}{長明|ちょうめい}, author of {方丈記|ほうじょうき}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {隠者|いんじゃ}: hermit, recluse — more formal, literary
- ⟦{仙人|せんにん}→仙人：11607_sennin⟧: hermit, sage — mythical/supernatural connotation
- ⟦{引|ひ}きこもり→引きこもり：10491_hikikomori⟧: shut-in — modern term, negative connotation
